shortDescription: Gargash Group is a diversified UAE conglomerate operating across automotive distribution, real estate, financial services, and hospitality.
whatTheyDo: Gargash Group serves as the authorized UAE distributor for automotive brands including Mercedes-Benz, Alfa Romeo, and GAC Motor, alongside operating Sixt rent-a-car and leasing. Its operations also encompass Gargash Real Estate development and asset management through Daman Investments. In the UAE, the group runs centralized corporate functions and automotive technical service teams.

notes: Gargash Group operates multiple corporate offices and showrooms along Sheikh Zayed Road and across Dubai; no single specific head office street number is published.

shortDescription: GateX (GateX IOT Global Positioning Systems Trading LLC) develops IoT sensors, telematics, and automated fuel management systems in Dubai.
whatTheyDo: GateX designs and supplies IoT monitoring hardware and software solutions including real-time fuel management systems, RFID vehicle identification, and GPS fleet tracking. In the UAE, it serves commercial fleets, fuel distributors, and construction enterprises. The engineering team in Dubai Silicon Oasis handles technical integration and support.
address: Office 417, IT Plaza, Dubai Silicon Oasis, Dubai, UAE

shortDescription: General Electric (GE) operates regional hubs in Dubai Internet City covering energy infrastructure and aerospace technology across the Middle East.
whatTheyDo: General Electric historically managed broad energy, healthcare, and aviation operations from Dubai Internet City. Following its corporate separation into GE Aerospace and GE Vernova, its entities maintain facilities in Dubai providing regional engineering support, grid solutions, power system maintenance, and corporate services.
address: Building 18, Dubai Internet City, Dubai, UAE

shortDescription: Generation 3D is a Dubai-based 3D printing and design company specializing in additive manufacturing and architectural modeling.
whatTheyDo: Generation 3D operates a 10,000 sq ft production facility in Al Quoz equipped with robotic arms and over 50 3D printers. It provides architectural scale models, digital CAD-to-fabrication workflows, and custom 3D-printed architectural and interior elements for AEC clients.
address: 46 - 48 26th St, Al Quoz Industrial Area 4, Dubai, UAE

whatTheyDo: The company operates retail showrooms and wholesale distribution of travel luggage, handbags, leather goods, and travel accessories under the brand Shonati. Its primary operational base is in Sharjah with a retail branch in Wafi Mall, Dubai.

shortDescription: Global Feeder Shipping (GFS) is a Dubai-based container feeder operator connecting regional ports with major maritime hubs.
whatTheyDo: Global Feeder Shipping provides container feeder shipping services linking trade lanes across the Middle East, Indian Subcontinent, Southeast Asia, and Africa.
